name: RecurLocal
status: FEASIBILITY ANSWERED, and the answer is negative on every device reachable here. The persist ceiling is 2*min(persisting_capacity, footprint)/step_traffic and the numerator is pinned at 60 MiB by the hardware: weighted across the section 44 matrix on the best model found (sparse-MoE Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, a 3.56 GB decode step against a dense hybrid's 18.5), the persist family reaches 1.94% against this project's own 2.0% significance floor, with both dials at maximum and a bound that already assumes perfect replacement. The dense Qwen3.8-27B tops out at 0.52%. AND the MoE surface is NOT SCORABLE: four checkpoints were screened on hardware and none gives two unhooked greedy replays that agree - the runtime accepts only six expert tensor types (ruling out MXFP4 and every IQ variant at load), the two genuinely different quantizations exceed 32 GB of VRAM, and eight environment configurations on the checkpoint that does load all fork. The dense control is reproducible at the gate's 64 tokens and forks by 256, so it is not a clean control either. Two standing claims were retracted this session: capture_node is documented as safe by the CUDA header the project was reading around, and the dense concurrency-32 collapse is per-request device OOM - a failure the harness reported as a slowdown - not a decode-path fallback. The recommendation is to describe this as a locality-MEASUREMENT harness with a reference policy honestly bounded below its own floor
core: software-directed CUDA locality for mutable recurrent LLM state, embeddable in an inference runtime, with enumerated optimization surfaces measured against a real model rather than a microbenchmark
validated: Zero-warning CUDA build on sm_120, ctest 3/3, 102 Python checks, 319 planner checks (including a fabricated device-capability matrix that needs no GPU: A100-like, H100-like, a part whose persisting L2 is smaller than one layer's state, one with more persisting L2 than the whole footprint, one reporting zero, and one whose two capacity numbers contradict), 120 device-side controller checks, compute-sanitizer clean, install + find_package, a documented API/ABI stability contract with static_asserts a consumer's own build runs, and a standalone probe that reads an access-policy window back off a graph captured with the attribute set mid-capture, at 1 to 128 nodes
